report:
Reviewed the complete atomic-checking claim, including candidate isolation, multi-part equality atomicity, direct-parent-only commit, discarded equalities/wakes/obligations, and the linked architectural version invariants. Eight ordinary implementation associations now cover the essential code rather than only try_probe. In unify.rs, try_unify_batch and recursive structural unification run inside try_probe; success rebuilds/collapses once, while every error discards the child. egraph.rs keeps parent pointers, bounds, domains, ceilings, worklists and wakes in per-version state; collapse verifies a live sole leaf child and its direct parent, merges all state and transfers variable ownership, and discard clears all removed states without publishing effects. version.rs uses append-only handles/variable identities, ancestry visibility, leaf-only mutation and subtree tombstones. These enforce the linked stable-parent and sibling isolation qualifications; stash allocation is deliberately outside rollback.

infer_ctx.rs publishes wake effects only following commit_branch, while try_eq_in mutates the explicitly supplied child and discard_branch publishes nothing. obligations.rs represents staged parameter environments in an owned batch. method.rs creates a transaction before instantiating method generics and matching receiver/arguments; a failed match discards it before obligation publication. Success stages the environment, commits, and consumes the batch through publish_obligation_batch. solve/prove.rs creates independent query states for trait and normalization candidates, matches/evaluates in child versions, extracts responses, then discards those versions. boundary.rs instantiate_query creates fresh stash/egraph state, and response extraction maps a rejected candidate to QueryResultData::No with no substitution or residual obligation. Candidate versions are not merged into a requester, as specifically qualified by the linked RFD. Conjunctions stage all subgoals in one child and discard on No; successful/residual/uncertain responses retain their staged information in the isolated proof context. There is no rejected-alternative publication path in this inspected flow.

The complete ordinary test set contains four tests. batch_failure_is_atomic first binds an inference variable then fails a later equality and explicitly asserts the root variable remains unchanged. late_mismatch_rolls_back_earlier_equality exercises the same failure inside structural tuple decomposition and also asserts unchanged parent semantic revision. concrete_and_nested_unification verifies successful structural checking commits both the nested variable binding and tuple equality. external_method_mismatch_discards_partial_generic_bindings uses the captured synthetic external signature provider, successfully performs early generic matching, fails the second argument, and asserts no caller bound or root revision change. These bodies expose actual behavioral assertions and would detect eager publication of the tested earlier equalities.

The sole TODO test, sage_meta::todo::inference_atomic_checking, remains explicitly deferred. Its matrix calls for candidate partial-match rejection, exactly-once staged obligation publication on success, and isolated sibling candidate identities. The current method regression covers one rejection shape, but does not complete the general solver-candidate/scheduler observation matrix. Completion requires focused candidate fixtures and observation of obligation counts and sibling identities across acceptance/rejection; this report does not credit the empty TODO body as execution or full coverage. In particular the complete obligation/wake matrix and sibling scenario remain test debt, not missing production implementation hidden by a TODO. No N/A entries exist.

Executed cargo fmt; cargo test -p sage-ir --lib external_method_mismatch_discards_partial_generic_bindings passed (1 test), and cargo test -p sage-ir --lib check::infer::unify::tests passed all 19 tests. Only association comments and three existing-test attributes changed; no behavioral implementation was changed. Additional captured dependencies include the linked RFD and review policy. Build and required delegated post-codegen/Sage sanity checks are coordinated separately by the root agent and are not inferred from this source review.
